interactions.explanation: A separate provision removes a named category from the base liability cap. The base fee formula does not describe all covered exposure. A separate limit for the same named category was also located. Check scope, conditions and precedence together; do not label the whole agreement uncapped.

evidence.text: Each party’s aggregate liability will not exceed the Fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
The liability cap does not apply to indemnification obligations.
Indemnification liability is limited to two times the Fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
